    """
    Cross-modal attention: one modality attends to another.

    Source features query the target features to integrate cross-modal information.
    """

        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.head_dim = dim // num_heads
        self.scale = self.head_dim ** -0.5

        self.q_proj = nn.Linear(dim, dim)
        self.k_proj = nn.Linear(dim, dim)
        self.v_proj = nn.Linear(dim, dim)
        self.out_proj = nn.Linear(dim, dim)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)

    def forward(self, source, target):
        B, C, H, W = source.shape

        target_t = rearrange(target, "b c h w -> b (h w) c")

        q = self.q_proj(source_t)
        k = self.k_proj(target_t)
        v = self.v_proj(target_t)

        q = rearrange(q, "b n (h d) -> b h n d", h=self.num_heads)
        k = rearrange(k, "b n (h d) -> b h n d", h=self.num_heads)
        v = rearrange(v, "b n (h d) -> b h n d", h=self.num_heads)

        out = attn @ v

            nn.Sigmoid(),

    pred_anom = pred - climatology
